Page 63 Cont.
Apr. 29 Elgin Jeffery - presbiterian - 56 - fearful stomach - intestinal cancer - 7 operations last 8 months. Enrolled Today. . hardly able to stand the pain.
Helen Dzink - 25 - Seizures like Epileptic ... since five. Other- wise seemingly healthy and normal.
Page 64 Apr. 29 Isabell P. Joseph - 34 - stomach cancer two years. Thought to be dying - even dead four days ago .... still hangs on; Enrolled To-day in Ser. Mass Ass'n.
John Holloran - 21 - in Gt. Lakes Navy Y'd - Spinal maningitis, rather hopeless - we'll hope just the same.
Barbara Kleier - 10 - lutheran - hectic cough since about a year old - naturally sleeps poorly and very little apetite - also ear-drum pierced ....
· Mrs. Matilda Prieve - 68 - also Lutheran dropfonach and intestines - broken Knee and nearly every thing.
Antoinette Bellardello - 47 - stomach tuomer - Drs at Sea.
Mrs. Marg. Rice - 54 - Episcopelian - husband baptized a methodist, but while caring conscientiously for sick wife - hopelessly cancer- ous, has for years neglected going to church ... He promises to be earnest .... if wife is helpt .... sent home from Ford Hosp .... to die.
1943, May
Page 65 May Geo. Melin - 40 - of Cleveland raised Catholic - married a Catholic out of Church now in dying condition - even after reconciled to Church has so many doubts that he seems to still have protestant mind ....
3 Mrs. Stefania Patalon - 39 - mental has husband and three beautiful little children .... has not made Easter in years. Enrolled To-night - husband at least promising to do better and bring her To-morrow
Mrs. A. W. - 55 - seemingly a good worman but of late acting Very strangely. Her neighbors and friends are very strangely disapointed in her conduct .... for a conscience
Peter Christain - 33 - liver abcess and complication
Thomas M. Toolin - 55 - infection seemingly in whole system - sight failing.
